fullPassage: Dear Mayor Stanton, I've recently been informed that you are proposing a plan to renovate our city's great historic landmark, the Silverlight Theater. Your proposed plan to increase the theater's seating capacity to attract larger audiences and bring more world-class theatrical performances to the city may be financially sound. But everything I've heard and read in recent weeks leads me to believe that such a renovation would destroy the theater's architecture, which is among the best of its kind in the nation. With that in mind, I urge you to reconsider this renovation plan and to explore alternatives that will preserve the character of the Silverlight Theater while securing its financial stability. I strongly believe that we should not sacrifice the beauty and history of our city for short-sighted financial gain. Sincerely, Kate Hendricks

questions.passage: Dear Mayor Stanton, I've recently been informed that you are proposing a plan to (A)[renovate / abandon] our city's great historic landmark, the Silverlight Theater. Your proposed plan to increase the theater's seating capacity to attract larger audiences and bring more world-class theatrical performances to the city may be financially sound. But everything I've heard and read in recent weeks leads me to believe that such a renovation would (B)[destroy / enhance] the theater's architecture, which is among the best of its kind in the nation. With that in mind, I urge you to reconsider this renovation plan and to explore alternatives that will (C)[preserve / neglect] the character of the Silverlight Theater while securing its financial stability. I strongly believe that we should not sacrifice the beauty and history of our city for short-sighted financial gain. Sincerely, Kate Hendricks
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 시장이 극장을 개조(renovate)하려는 계획을 세우고 있고, 그런 개조가 건축물을 파괴(destroy)할 것이며, 극장의 특성을 보존(preserve)할 대안을 촉구한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① renovate — destroy — preserve — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② abandon — destroy — preserve (A 변경: 개조→포기)
❌ ③ renovate — enhance — preserve (B 반대: 파괴→향상)
❌ ④ renovate — destroy — neglect (C 반대: 보존→방치)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① reduce — reconsider — sacrifice (A 반대: 늘리다→줄이다)
❌ ② increase — approve — sacrifice (B 반대: 재고→승인)
❌ ③ increase — reconsider — celebrate (C 반대: 희생→축하)

questions.passage: Dear Mayor Stanton, I've recently been informed that you are proposing a plan to renovate our city's great historic landmark, the Silverlight Theater. Your proposed plan to increase the theater's seating capacity to attract larger audiences and bring more world-class theatrical performances to the city may be financially sound. But everything I've heard and read in recent weeks leads me to believe that such a renovation would destroy the theater's architecture, which is among the best of its kind in the nation. With that in mind, I urge you to reconsider this renovation plan and to explore alternatives that will preserve the character of the Silverlight Theater while securing its financial stability. I strongly believe that we should not sacrifice the beauty and history of our city for __________. Sincerely, Kate Hendricks
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 우리 도시의 아름다움과 역사를 '근시안적인 재정적 이득(short-sighted financial gain)'을 위해 희생해선 안 된다.
